notes: The reference CLI is pinned by version, not merely by name on PATH: XDR-JSON key spellings changed between releases. Releases before 28.0.0 emit the Rust keyword-escaped key 'type_' where SEP-0051 requires 'type'.

sdk_xdr_commit is the XDR pin this SDK generates from (Makefile XDR_COMMIT). It differs from xdr_commit, so the reference CLI cannot resolve types and enum members added after the commit it vendors. Those are reported as unresolvable rather than as mismatches.

sep_spec records the SEP-0051 revision this implementation was written against. It is the single recorded value the release watcher compares the published specification with; docs/sep/sep-51.md and the agent skill quote the same version and are updated alongside it.
